title: Item Rain
description: A simple mod that allow you to make items rain down from the sky onto players
body:
## Item Rain Mod

![Showcase](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c8327a1faec6246a02a0852254fd8ca7c19dff07_0.webp)


This mod introduces the `/ir` command, which controls all the item rain functionality.

### Command Syntax:
```
/ir <target> <item-name> [amount] [duration] [range] [height] [delay]

```
---

#  How to Use

### 1. Target

First, you must specify who the items will rain on. The command will not work if this parameter is missing.

![Example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8a3634211bf71318d7771b7aa556a86e2d161c16.png)

### 2. Item

Next, choose which item will fall from the sky.

![Example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8917e84c30f8d6d0198209de78117ea9a0c50abd.png)

If you want completely randomized item drops, simply type **`random`** instead of an item name.

![Example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c2a569e814fbe1d884c1fe61945fc785e671bccb.png)

### 3. Amount

Now, decide how fast and dense the items should fall.

* **Default:** 1
* **Minimum:** 1
* **Maximum:** 5
![Example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9c33754e69514a20a3150891df488077e1c5ad2f.png)

### 4. Duration

Specify how long (in seconds) the item rain will last.

* **Default:** 10 seconds

![Example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a46d26cd655eb20aa82d5f2c84ce50c0f1616c52.png)

### 5. Range

Determine the horizontal radius (in blocks) around the target where the items will scatter.

* **Default:** 10 blocks

![Example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/630c2ebcb32cafbf284074e11ee65ad7c953eb37.png)

### 6. Height

Choose how high above the target the items will spawn and begin their descent.

* **Default:** 20 blocks

![Example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/579756889cd264a9b69caf2688182ba37d0c3f0f.png)

### 7. Delay

Finally, you can add a countdown timer (in seconds) before the rain starts. **This is completely optional.**

![Example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b596f10e0964914780e0d5247a943eb346aaef42.png)
![Example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c4da01c3ac42744c97d644c866aefc8339bb05b7.png)
---

## Stop the Rain

If the chaos gets out of hand, you can clear all active rain effects instantly by running:

```minecraft
/ir stop

```

![Example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3dccb62a8ae4756e3d8ef35807c79f753be68f2d.png)

**NOTE:** You can also launch a quick rain by typing **only the target and the item name**.

![Example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bc3d940a459cf37c5e09e8809c200a2c38531438.png)

---

## Example

``` /ir Username minecraft:redstone ``` 

``` /ir YourFriend minecraft:cobblestone 5 ```

``` /ir stop ```
